Nivea Cream Nivea Cream is one of the most famous skincare products in the world. It was created in 1911 in Germany. The cream is easy to recognize because it comes in a round blue metal tin with a white Nivea logo. The cream is white, thick and soft. It has a pleasant, gentle smell. Its main purpose is to moisturize and protect the skin. It helps keep the skin soft, smooth and healthy. It can be used on different parts of the body, such as the face, hands, elbows and legs. Nivea Cream is popular among people of different ages. Both children and adults can use it. It is especially useful when the skin becomes dry because of cold weather or wind. The cream creates a protective layer on the skin and helps keep moisture inside. One of the best things about Nivea Cream is its simple packaging and affordable price. It is easy to find in shops and supermarkets in many countries. People have trusted this product for more than one hundred years. Today, Nivea is a well-known brand that produces many skincare products, including creams, lotions, shampoos and deodorants. Nivea Cream remains one of its most popular products.    #fyp #nivea#2017#strangerthings#щп …
